name: k3s Kubernetes
author: Rancher / CNCF
description: Lightweight certified Kubernetes (k3s) optimized for ARM64. Installs a fully functional single-node control-plane and worker.
notes: Once installation completes, switch to the Terminal tab and run "kubectl get nodes" or "kubectl get pods -A" to monitor your cluster. Kubeconfig is saved at /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml.

name: Portainer CE
author: Portainer.io
description: Powerful web-based management UI for Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks.
notes: After deployment, open http://localhost:9000 in your browser to create your admin account and manage containers visually.

name: VS Code Server
author: Coder
description: Full Visual Studio Code IDE running inside your browser with extensions, integrated terminal, and file explorer.
notes: Access your IDE at http://localhost:8443 in your browser. Default password is "linxr".

name: Node.js 20 LTS
author: Node.js Foundation
description: Node.js 20 LTS JavaScript and TypeScript runtime environment with npm package manager.
notes: Exec into the container or connect via Terminal to run Node applications, scripts, or build tools.

name: Python 3.11 Runtime
author: Python Software Foundation
description: Python 3 runtime pre-configured with pip for scripts, web backends, and data science utilities.

name: Ollama LLM Engine
author: Ollama / Alpine
description: Run local open-source Large Language Models (Llama 3, Phi-3, Mistral, Gemma) directly on ARM64.
notes: Lightweight build (~72 MB): CPU-optimized Alpine Ollama engine that downloads in seconds and saves disk space. API listens on port 11434. Pull small models like "ollama pull smollm:135m" to run on mobile.

name: Nginx Web Server
author: Nginx Inc.
description: High-performance HTTP server, reverse proxy, and static file server with minimal memory footprint.
notes: Web server is live at http://localhost:8088. Access directly from Chrome on your phone.

name: PostgreSQL 16
author: PostgreSQL Global Development Group
description: Powerful open-source object-relational database system with full ACID compliance and JSON support.
notes: Connect with: host=localhost, port=5432, user=postgres, password=linxr, db=linxr.

name: Redis In-Memory Store
author: Redis Ltd.
description: Ultra-fast in-memory key-value database, cache, message broker, and streaming engine.
notes: Redis CLI is ready at localhost:6379 without authentication.

name: Eclipse Mosquitto MQTT
author: Eclipse Foundation
description: Lightweight MQTT message broker for IoT device telemetry, home automation, and sensor networks.
notes: MQTT broker listening on port 1883.

name: C/C++ Build Essentials
author: Alpine Linux
description: Installs gcc, g++, make, musl-dev, git, and cmake inside Alpine for compiling native C/C++ projects.
script: apk update && apk add --no-cache build-base cmake git linux-headers
notes: Once installed, use gcc/g++ and make in the Terminal tab to build native libraries and binaries.

name: Go Programming Language
author: Google / Go Authors
description: Installs the Go compiler and toolchain inside Alpine Linux for building microservices and tools.
notes: Verify installation in the Terminal tab using "go version".

name: Rust Toolchain & Cargo
author: Rust Foundation
description: Installs the official Rust compiler (rustc) and Cargo package manager for high-performance systems development.
script: apk update && apk add --no-cache rust cargo
notes: Verify installation using "rustc --version" and "cargo --version" in the Terminal tab.

name: Grafana Dashboards
author: Grafana Labs
description: Operational dashboards for monitoring metrics, traces, and system health.
notes: Access the dashboard at http://localhost:3000 in your browser. Default login is admin / admin.

name: Zyvr — Asterisk PBX (Docker)
author: AI2TH / Asterisk
description: Containerized Asterisk 20 PBX telephony server. Run isolated SIP PBX in Docker or daemonless FastTrack OCI mode.
notes: Runs Asterisk inside an isolated container. Connect SIP softphones to port 5060. WebRTC/HTTP listens on port 8088. View channel status with 'asterisk -rvvv' via Terminal.

name: Zyvr — Asterisk PBX (Native Linux)
author: AI2TH / Asterisk
description: Full Asterisk 20 PBX telephony server installed natively into Alpine Linux. Features PJSIP SIP stack, SRTP encryption, voicemail, and WebRTC bridge with zero container overhead.
script: sed -i 's/https:/http:/g' /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null || true && apk update && apk add --no-cache asterisk asterisk-sample-config asterisk-sounds-en asterisk-srtp openssl python3 && mkdir -p /etc/asterisk /var/log/asterisk /var/spool/asterisk /var/run/asterisk && chown -R asterisk:asterisk /var/run/asterisk /var/log/asterisk /var/spool/asterisk /etc/asterisk && rc-update add asterisk default 2>/dev/null || true && (rc-service asterisk restart 2>/dev/null || asterisk -U asterisk -G asterisk) && echo 'Zyvr Asterisk PBX installed successfully!'
notes: Native Asterisk PBX listening on port 5060 (SIP UDP/TCP) and 8088 (HTTP/WebSockets). Connect any SIP softphone (Linphone, Zoiper, MicroSIP) to 127.0.0.1:5060. Manage dialplan via /etc/asterisk/extensions.conf.

name: Zabbix Server & Web UI (Docker)
author: Zabbix LLC
description: Complete Zabbix enterprise monitoring appliance with integrated Zabbix Server, Web Frontend, and SQLite storage.
notes: Access the Zabbix Web UI at http://localhost:8080 in your mobile browser. Default login: Admin / zabbix.

name: Zabbix Agent (Native Linux)
author: Zabbix LLC
description: Installs the official Zabbix monitoring agent daemon natively in Alpine Linux. Collects host CPU, memory, storage, network traffic, and process metrics.
script: sed -i 's/https:/http:/g' /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null || true && apk update && apk add --no-cache zabbix-agent zabbix-utils && rc-update add zabbix-agent default 2>/dev/null || true && (rc-service zabbix-agent restart 2>/dev/null || zabbix_agentd) && echo 'Zabbix Agent running on port 10050!'
notes: Zabbix agent listens on port 10050. Edit /etc/zabbix/zabbix_agentd.conf to set Server=<your-zabbix-server-ip> and Hostname=<node-name>.

name: Nginx Web Server (Native Linux)
author: Nginx Inc. / Alpine
description: High-performance HTTP web server installed natively into Alpine Linux. Minimal memory usage (<5 MB) without container layers.
script: sed -i 's/https:/http:/g' /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null || true && apk update && apk add --no-cache nginx && rc-update add nginx default 2>/dev/null || true && rc-service nginx restart 2>/dev/null || nginx
notes: Native Nginx server is live at http://localhost:8088. Root document directory: /var/lib/nginx/html.

name: PostgreSQL 16 (Native Linux)
author: PostgreSQL Global Dev Group
description: Installs PostgreSQL 16 server and client tools natively into Alpine Linux. High-speed SQL engine running with direct system I/O.
script: sed -i 's/https:/http:/g' /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null || true && apk update && apk add --no-cache postgresql postgresql-contrib && /etc/init.d/postgresql setup 2>/dev/null || true && rc-update add postgresql default 2>/dev/null || true && rc-service postgresql restart 2>/dev/null || su - postgres -c 'pg_ctl start -D /var/lib/postgresql/data' || true
notes: Native PostgreSQL active on port 5432. Connect via 'su - postgres -c psql' in Terminal.

name: Redis In-Memory Cache (Native Linux)
author: Redis Ltd. / Alpine
description: Ultra-fast in-memory key-value database installed natively into Alpine Linux. Zero container abstraction latency.
script: sed -i 's/https:/http:/g' /etc/apk/repositories 2>/dev/null || true && apk update && apk add --no-cache redis && rc-update add redis default 2>/dev/null || true && rc-service redis restart 2>/dev/null || redis-server --daemonize yes
notes: Native Redis server active on localhost:6379. Connect via 'redis-cli' in Terminal.
